info.name: Clothes Shop API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Clothes Shop backend.

## Setup
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Set the `baseUrl` variable to `http://localhost:3000` (already set)
3. Run **[SETUP] Admin Login** first — the token is saved automatically
4. Run scenarios top-to-bottom within each folder

## Variables (auto-managed)
- `baseUrl` — server base URL
- `adminToken` — saved automatically after admin login
- `sessionId` — a fixed customer session UUID
- `createdItemId` — saved after creating a test item
- `createdCategoryId` — saved after creating a test category
- `orderId` — saved after placing a test order
